data.plainLyric:
I found a secret note, "Burn after reading this"
It's supernatural, the feeling's sinking in
This isn't cold feet, these aren't fireworks
The sky is menacing and that's an iceberg
He thinks he's velvet smooth
I've fallen for the act
I'm in the other room and seeing through the cracks
The voices in my head are screaming, "No! Don't!"
You don't have to waste your night
And wear your heart out
The warning signs are flashing now
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Even though the table's set
The guests are waiting
You can burn the dress, and run away
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
You've been such a good girl
Talking like you should, girl
Keep avoiding, disappointing, in your white satin heels
But you know how you really feel
You don't have to waste your night
And wear your heart out
The warning signs are flashing now
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Even though the table's set
The guests are waiting
You can burn the dress and run away
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
(Ah-ah, ah-ah)
(Ah-ah, ah-ah)
Stop the wedding
Stop the wedding
If your heart is dreading
Hands are sweating
While the sun is setting
You'll be getting out
Stop the wedding
Stop the wedding
If your heart is dreading
Hands are sweating
While the sun is setting
You'll be getting out
You don't have to waste your life
And wear your heart out
The warning signs are flashing now
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding!
Your heart was set on never breaking
You can burn the dress and run away
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding! (Ah-ah)
Stop the wedding!
Only you can stop the wedding (stop the wedding)
Ah-ah (stop the wedding)
Only you can (stop the wedding)
